subject: general
question: Which initiative announced in the Union Budget 2026–27 aims to strengthen market access for rural women-led enterprises?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Self Help Entrepreneur Marts**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• The **Self Help Entrepreneur Marts** initiative was unveiled in the **Union Budget 2026-27** as a strategic intervention to scale up the commercial viability of products made by **rural women**.

• These marts are designed to serve as specialized retail and distribution centers that provide **direct market linkages**, effectively eliminating middle-level intermediaries and ensuring higher profit margins for **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**.

• The primary objective of this initiative is to provide a dedicated **branding and marketing platform** for diverse rural products, ranging from traditional **handicrafts and handlooms** to organic agricultural produce and processed foods.

• By establishing these marts in **strategic urban locations** and transit hubs, the government aims to enhance the visibility of **women-led enterprises** and tap into the growing consumer demand for authentic, locally-made goods.

• The initiative supports the **economic empowerment** of women in rural areas by transforming traditional livelihood activities into scalable **micro-enterprises**, thereby fostering rural entrepreneurship and **financial inclusion**.

 **Additional Information__**

• **Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM):**

• The mission is the foundational framework for organizing **rural poor women** into SHGs, providing them with continuous support for **income-generating activities**.

• It plays a critical role in the deployment of the **Self Help Entrepreneur Marts** by identifying high-potential SHGs and providing them with necessary training.

• **Lakhpati Didi Scheme:**

• This initiative targets making **3 crore women** in SHGs 'Lakhpati Didis' by ensuring an annual household income of at least **Rs 1 lakh**.

• The introduction of dedicated marts directly facilitates this goal by expanding the **sales volume** and market reach of SHG-produced commodities.

• **E-commerce and Digital Integration:**

• The marts are expected to be integrated with the **Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC)** and the **Government e-Marketplace (GeM)** to enable a **hybrid retail model** (offline and online).

• This integration ensures that **rural women-led enterprises** can participate in the digital economy and reach a nationwide customer base.
